title: Choice that most can’t make at all…
content:
Jaan kehne se koi Jaan nhi hota hai,

Haan ji … Jaan kehne se koi Jaan nhi hota hai,

Koi keh le bhi nuksaan nhi hota hai !!!

Ye toh mai hoon, k jise chhod diya.. chhod diya

Ye toh mai hoon, k jise chhod diya.. chhod diya

Varna ye faisla aasan nhi hota hai !!!

Just because you called me “love” don’t think you held my soul,

Words are cheap, and breath is easy—an effortless role.

There is no wound in a title, no scar in a hollow name,

Anyone can whisper sacrifice, while they’re exiting the frame.

There is no cost to a whisper, no tax on a lie,

To call someone love as you wave them goodbye.

You think you walked away, but I’m the one who let you go.

I watched you choose the easy path,

and I didn’t say no.

It takes a certain kind of woman to let a bridge simply burn,

To stand amidst the falling ash and never once look back or turn.

If it were any other, they’d have shattered at your feet,

They’d have filled the air with salt and tears to make the loss complete. They would have begged, and screamed, and pleaded for the “us” we used to be—

But that’s a brand of desperation that was never meant for me.

Don’t mistake my steady hands for a heart that doesn’t feel,

Or think that being “left” has made my spirit any less real.

I simply have too much pride to fight for a space you didn’t give,

And too much fire in my blood to beg for the right to live.

Go on and tell your story—tell them that the break was light,

That I was cold, or reached the end, or didn’t put up a fight.

But keep this truth behind your teeth:

you only survived the fall,

Because I’m the one who made a choice that most can’t make at all.
